title: PlayStation Home (2008)/MallWorld
content: I woke up from crazy MallWorld dreaming and this was the first video I saw. I was taken aback by how MallWorld this seemed for me. I didn’t have a PlayStation growing up and never heard of this til now, but some of you might have. Just wanted to share. It also reminded me about a lot of the other MallWorld-type dreams where I’m sucked into a game much like this.
